mechanism.adaptation: FAP-neutral candidate digest and observations; advisory advance/rollback only

constraints: FAP planner remains authoritative for plan construction and action selection.
FAP critic and verification remain authoritative for success and completion.
The canary gate cannot execute, promote, verify, or mark a goal complete.
Evidence is isolated per rollout stage and duplicate evidence cannot fill a stage.
Candidate digest mismatches and invalid thresholds fail closed.
This import does not introduce FCA connectome control into FAP.
